title: Detection Engine Findings
description: Output of Person 2 (Detection Engine). Consumed by Person 3 (Remediation Generator) and Person 4 (Dashboard). Authored by Person 1 as v1 per Section 2 contract.

finding_id.description: Stable unique ID for this finding. Person 3 and Person 4 reference findings by this ID.

pattern_name.description: Human-readable name of the detected escalation pattern or rule.

path.description: Ordered list of ARNs forming the privilege escalation path, from least to most privileged.

risk_score.description: Composite risk score 0–100. Must always be accompanied by risk_breakdown.

risk_breakdown.description: 3-factor breakdown making the score explainable. Score = Reachability × Blast_radius × Exploit_triviality (normalized to 0–100).

narrative.description: Plain-English attack story for this finding.

offending_statement.description: The specific policy statement that enables or contributes to this finding.
